questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Merging traffic.
questions.explanation: This yellow sign with black markings warns you that traffic will merge from the right. Be ready to allow merging traffic to enter safely.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
The road ahead turns sharply left, then right.
The road ahead curves to the left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply right and then sharply left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Sharp turn ahead, slow down.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a sharp turn ahead. Reduce your speed before you reach the turn.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must turn left or right.
You are approaching a T intersection.
The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
You are on an overpass above a divided highway.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road that you are on intersects with a divided highway.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that your road crosses a divided highway. A divided highway has two one-way roads separated by a median or barrier.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Crossroad ahead. Watch for traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a crossroad is ahead. Be alert for cross traffic.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: All traffic must go straight ahead.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: A road joins from the right.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that a road will join from the right at an intersection ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must bear either right or left.
A road joins from the right.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must bear either right or left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns of a Y intersection ahead. You must choose to go either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Drive with caution and be ready to slow down.
Do not drive in this lane.
You must come to a complete stop and yield the right-of-way.
Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.

questions.correctAnswerText: Slow down, be prepared to stop, and, if necessary, yield the right-of-way.
questions.explanation: This triangular sign means you must yield. Slow down and be ready to stop. Let other vehicles, bicyclists, and pedestrians pass before you continue.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: T intersection.
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to a T intersection ahead. Prepare to turn either right or left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: An upcoming curve in the road.

questions.correctAnswerText: An upcoming curve in the road.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road ahead curves to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A community service group is picking up trash along the highway ahead.
Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
There is a pedestrian crosswalk ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: Workers are on or very close to the road in the work zone ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that workers may be on or near the road ahead. Slow down and be extra careful in this area.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Do not enter.
questions.explanation: This sign means it is unsafe to enter this road or driveway from your current direction. You must turn around and find a different route.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Steep downgrade ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a steep downhill section is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: A divided highway begins.
questions.explanation: This sign shows that the road ahead splits into a divided highway with traffic going each direction separated by a median. Stay to the right of the divider.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The traffic signal ahead is displaying a red light.
The traffic signal ahead is broken.
The traffic signal ahead is displaying a green light.
There is a traffic signal ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: There is a traffic signal ahead.
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that a traffic signal is at the next intersection.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don’t park on the right side of the street.

questions.correctAnswerText: No right turn.
questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash through a symbol means that action is not allowed. This sign prohibits right turns.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Keep right.
questions.explanation: This sign shows a divided highway is starting ahead. The road will split into two one-way sections separated by a median. You must stay to the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Slippery when wet.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road surface becomes slippery when it is wet.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: You may make left turns.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a lane reserved only for left turns from either direction. You cannot use this lane for passing or driving straight through.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Driving with your headlights out of alignment because one side of your car is higher than the other.
Damaging a tire from drifting onto the shoulder.
Hydroplaning, if the shoulder has water on it.
Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.

questions.correctAnswerText: Losing control of the vehicle if you drift onto the shoulder.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the shoulder is lower than the main road ahead. If a wheel drops onto the low shoulder, do not brake hard or turn sharply. This can cause you to lose control. Instead, ease back onto the road gently.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Red, yellow, green.
questions.explanation: Traffic signals arranged vertically always have red on top and green on bottom. Signals arranged horizontally always have red on the left and green on the right.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: There is an object on the roadway.
Traffic is coming from the right.
The road is curving sharply to the left.
There is a merge point ahead.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road is curving sharply to the left.
questions.explanation: Chevron signs show that the road curves sharply in the direction of the arrow. Multiple chevron signs may be placed throughout the curve.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.correctAnswerText: Green, yellow, and red.
questions.explanation: Traffic light colors from bottom to top are green, yellow, and red.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.

questions.correctAnswerText: Traffic flows only in the direction of the arrow.
questions.explanation: This one-way sign tells you that traffic can only flow in the direction shown by the arrow.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must travel at the speed indicated.
The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
You must travel through the intersection at the posted speed.

questions.correctAnswerText: The maximum legal speed on the roadway is 55 mph.
questions.explanation: This sign shows the maximum legal speed for the road. In bad weather or poor conditions like rain, snow, or ice, you should drive slower than the posted limit.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
You may drive in the left lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Keep to the side indicated by the arrow.
questions.explanation: This "Keep right" sign warns that a traffic island, median, or barrier is ahead. You must keep to the right of it.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: A road joins from the right.
The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.

questions.correctAnswerText: The road ahead turns sharply right, then sharply left.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road will turn sharply to the right and then sharply to the left.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.

questions.correctAnswerText: Entrances from the wrong direction on one-way streets and expressway ramps.
questions.explanation: This sign warns that the road is one-way traffic only. You must not enter from your current direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
Specific turning movements are allowed from specific lanes.
Drivers in both lanes are responsible for merging smoothly.

questions.correctAnswerText: The left lane is reserved for vehicles with a specific number of occupants.
questions.explanation: This sign marks a high occupancy vehicle (HOV) lane. These lanes are reserved for buses and vehicles with a driver plus one or more passengers, as shown on the sign.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: May either continue through the interchange or exit the freeway from your current lane.
May stay in your lane and continue through the interchange.
Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.

questions.correctAnswerText: Must exit the freeway, if you stay in your current lane.
questions.explanation: An "Exit only" sign means that lane does not continue through the interchange. If you are in that lane, you can change lanes to go through the interchange or you must exit the highway.
